name: cpubound
description: Identical CPU-bound handler (~5 ms busy-spin per invocation) on each platform; the SAQEF protocol. Runs are COUNT-BOUND (exactly total requests); duration is a safety cap only.

regression.description: c=4, 8-core bare metal, REPEAT=5, calibrated IDLE_W=4.3. Must reproduce the known-good medians (fn 10.46 / openfaas 7.67) within tolerance_pp, or the refactor is NOT trusted. OpenFaaS runs first, torn down (stack rm + service rm hello), then Fn.
